judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the TDD planning and red-test phase, stopping before implementing any production code. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (`ajv` dependency) are completely untouched, meaning all four newly added acceptance tests fail immediately. Furthermore, none of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` or `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were added, nor were the required documentation and changelog updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`). While `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` and the initial acceptance test scenarios are well-aligned with the ticket's requirements, the implementation itself is entirely missing.
